people.name: Mary
people.line: Sister of Martha and Lazarus, sat at Jesus' feet.

translations.web: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.
translations.bsb: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, believed in Him.
translations.kjv: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
translations.asv: Many therefore of the Jews, who came to Mary and beheld that which he did, believed on him.
